## Duration-typed capability fields are String although jmap_jscalendar_types::Duration exists
Crates: jmap-calendars-types, jmap-tasks-types
Evidence: crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/capability.rs:57 `max_expanded_query_duration: String` and :83 `max_availability_duration: String`. crate-jmap-tasks-types/src/capability.rs:82 `max_expanded_query_duration: String`. The spec types them as Duration: draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-33.txt:349 and :374, draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06.txt:299. Both crates already depend on jmap-jscalendar-types, which exports `Duration(String)` (crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/src/lib.rs:144). Sibling fields in the same structs are typed (`min_date_time: UTCDate`, `LocalDateTime`). In the probe I had to keep CalendarsBackend::limits() (`max_expanded_query_duration_seconds: u64`, calendars-server backend.rs CalendarsLimits) and the advertised String in sync by hand.
Why breaking later: These are pub fields on public wire structs, so changing `String` to `Duration` breaks every reader and constructor. The wire format is the same, so the change costs nothing now and needs a major version later.
Fix: Type all three fields as `jmap_jscalendar_types::Duration`.
